# Kitchen Knife Guru

> A comprehensive resource for selecting, maintaining, and mastering kitchen knives with expert guides on brands, sharpening, and cutting board care.

Kitchen Knife Guru provides in-depth buying guides, maintenance tutorials, and professional recommendations for home cooks and culinary enthusiasts. The site covers major knife brands including Shun, Wusthof, Global, and MAC, with detailed comparisons and expert advice on knife selection and care.

## Key Topics

- Chef Knives
- Japanese Chef Knives
- Knife Sharpening
- Honing Steel

- Shun Knives
- Wusthof Knives

- Knife Edges
- Kitchen Tools

## Chef Knives & Selection

- [Knives](https://www.kitchenknifeguru.com/knives): Main knives section featuring brands like Shun, Bob Kramer, chef knife guides and recommendations.
- [Best Chef Knives – Six Recommendations](https://www.kitchenknifeguru.com/knives/best-chef-knives-six-recommendations): Buying guide comparing six top chef knives from Wusthof, Global, MAC and other brands.
- [Best Japanese Chef Knives – Six Recommends](https://www.kitchenknifeguru.com/knives/best-japanese-chef-knives-six-recommends): Recommendations for six Japanese chef knives from Shun, Miyabi, Global and MAC.
- [How to Buy a Great Chef Knife](https://www.kitchenknifeguru.com/knives/how-to-buy-a-great-chef-knife): Tutorial on selecting a chef knife considering balance, edge retention and other factors.

## Knife Brand Guides

- [Shun Knives: a Buyer's Guide](https://www.kitchenknifeguru.com/shun-knives-buyers-guide): In-depth buyer's guide to Shun knife collections with strengths, weaknesses and photos.
- [Wusthof Knives — a Buyer's Guide](https://www.kitchenknifeguru.com/wusthof-knives-a-buyers-guide): Comprehensive guide to Wusthof German knives with recommendations and comparisons.

## Knife Sharpening & Professional Services

- [Sharpeners](https://www.kitchenknifeguru.com/sharpeners): Main sharpeners section covering professional services and sharpening guides.
- [Kitchen Knife Sharpening Action Plan](https://www.kitchenknifeguru.com/sharpeners/kitchen-knife-sharpening-action-plan): Nine-step action plan for keeping kitchen knives sharp with maintenance tips.
- [The Sharpening Cycle](https://www.kitchenknifeguru.com/sharpeners/sharpening-cycle): Illustrated guide showing knife edge wear and the difference between honing and sharpening.
- [Why Use a Professional Knife Sharpening Service?](https://www.kitchenknifeguru.com/sharpeners/why-professional-knife-sharpening): Five reasons to use professional knife sharpening services for busy lifestyles.
- [Finding a Professional Sharpening Service](https://www.kitchenknifeguru.com/sharpeners/finding-a-professional-sharpening-service): Guide to finding quality professional knife sharpening services with quality assessment tips.
- [Reviews of Professional Knife Sharpening Services](https://www.kitchenknifeguru.com/sharpeners/reviews-of-professional-knife-sharpening-services): In-depth reviews of Bozeman Knife Sharpening and KySharp with test results.

## Honing & Edge Maintenance

- [Hones/Steels](https://www.kitchenknifeguru.com/honesandsteels): Main honing steels section covering maintenance tools and cutting edge alignment.
- [What's a Honing Steel?](https://www.kitchenknifeguru.com/honesandsteels/whats-a-honing-steel): In-depth explanation of honing steels and their role in knife maintenance.
- [How to Hone a Knife and Keep It Sashimi Sharp](https://www.kitchenknifeguru.com/honesandsteels/how-to-hone-a-knife): Complete honing tutorial with illustrations, videos and downloadable cheat sheet.
- [Honing Cheat Sheet](https://www.kitchenknifeguru.com/honesandsteels/honing-cheat-sheet): Quick-reference printable guide for honing kitchen knives with vital points.

## Knife Science & Education

- [Knife Edges 101](https://www.kitchenknifeguru.com/knives/knife-edges-101): Educational guide on knife edge types, sharpening angles and microscopic blade anatomy.

## Cutting Boards & Knife Care

- [Cutting Boards](https://www.kitchenknifeguru.com/cutting-boards): Main cutting boards section covering materials and knife-friendly board options.
- [Cutting Boards — What's Better, Wood or Plastic?](https://www.kitchenknifeguru.com/cutting-boards/cutting-boards-wood-and-plastic): Comprehensive comparison of wood and plastic cutting boards for knife protection.
